newsitem.title: UK: Lehman raises year-end FTSE 100 forecast to 5,000.
newsitem.headline: Lehman raises year-end FTSE 100 forecast to 5,000.

text.p: Lehman Brothers on Monday raised its year-end target for the FTSE 100 index to 5,000 from 4,600, based on the bond yield gap, strategist Ian Scott told Reuters.
Scott said UK equities look cheaply-valued given where bond yields currently stand.
"The market is around six percent below what fair value is at the moment and we think gilt yields could still fall a bit further," he said.
